description: This file declares functions, macros, and includes other headers related to engine mathematical calculations and configurations in a vehicle engine control system.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the algorithm mode for engine load computation, with configuration suffix support.

methods.name: assertEngineReference
methods.description: Macro to assert that the engine reference is not null.

methods.name: setFlatInjectorLag
methods.description: Sets the delay time for the injector lag.

methods.name: fixAngle
methods.description: Macro to fix an angle value, with messaging and error code support.

methods.name: getCrankshaftRevolutionTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the time in milliseconds to rotate the crankshaft by one revolution at given RPM.

methods.name: getEngineCycleDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of an engine cycle in milliseconds based on RPM.

methods.name: getEngineLoadT
methods.description: Calculates and returns the engine load parameter.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Returns the spark dwell time at a given RPM.

methods.name: getCurrentIgnitionMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current ignition mode setting.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionPinIndices
methods.description: Initializes ignition pin indices based on current ignition mode.

methods.name: getCylinderId
methods.description: Returns the cylinder ID for a given index.

methods.name: setFuelRpmBin
methods.description: Configures RPM bins for fuel control.

methods.name: setFuelLoadBin
methods.description: Configures load bins for fuel control.

methods.name: setTimingRpmBin
methods.description: Configures RPM bins for timing control.

methods.name: setTimingLoadBin
methods.description: Configures load bins for timing control.

methods.name: setSingleCoilDwell
methods.description: Configures dwell time for single coil ignition system.
